# Paths that do not belong to a product pull request (Review gate, report only until GATE_NEW=enforce).
# Read from the BASE branch. One rule per line: `always: PATTERN` (any branch) or `feature: PATTERN` (only on feature/* and fix/*).
# The label stray-ok exempts a pull request. Patterns are fnmatch (`*` also matches `/`).
always: .devin/*
always: .cursor/*
always: .idea/*
always: .vscode/*
feature: .gitignore
